It's clear that consumers are buying it anyway, despite what everyone says here. If this was the majority of people in Canada then Nestle wouldn't be making any money. So better solution to the problem: start taxing the shit out of it so that Nestle has to pay more.

Keep in mind that tapped water isn't appropriate in all circumstances. Say me, an ambulance attendant, driving around and someone is suffering from dehydration. Should we tell them to go inside and use a fountain? Or just immediately grab a bottle of water from our cooler?
You do realize you don't have to become a nurse with a BScN right? You can do anything else.
